tess: Quick check: should HTTP/2 multiplexing be default for upstream streams?
jamie: Default-on improves perf but risk head-of-line blocking for short calls.
igor: If default, enforce limits: max_streams_per_conn, per-tenant quotas, idle timeouts.
chen: Define retry behavior when a multiplexed conn dies: restart vs resume. Resume seems complex unless opt-in.
sam: Agree. Resume only if upstream supports checkpointing or we provide Resume-Token. Otherwise restart.
jamie: Proposal: three classes - non-retryable, restartable, resumable (opt-in).
igor: Resume-token should be HMAC-signed by edge, contain route id, expiry, nonce. Stateless verification.
chen: Single-use tokens need in-memory seen-set with TTL to detect replays. Bound memory by tenant.
tess: Route config example? multiplexing: auto|off|force, max_streams_per_conn, streaming.resume.enabled, resume_window_ms.
sam: I'll open a PR with manifest snippet.
jamie: I'll run load tests: many short requests + some long streams to measure H-o-L.
ops-bot: deploy-bot pushed edge-proxy v2.1 to staging.
tess: Action items captured: sam PR, igor token spec, jamie load tests, chen compare edge vs upstream tokens. We'll reconvene after tests.
